title: Follow vocabulary between language, requirements, and code

steps.action: Create a term with a name, definition, alias, story link, record link, and exact defining-code link.
steps.expected_result: The complete term loads as active and each linked endpoint can identify it.

steps.action: Open the term, its story, and its defining source location.
steps.expected_result: Each surface links back to the same stable term record.

steps.action: Rename the defining declaration without revising the term.
steps.expected_result: The term code link is marked stale and still shows the pinned definition.

steps.action: Revise the term to the renamed declaration.
steps.expected_result: The new term revision is current and the code link is no longer stale.

expected_result: A term preserves its name, definition, aliases, story and code links in both directions, and a changed defining line is visibly stale.
